main_text.l: glia[?] Papales nuncij, pro colligendis pecunijs, de quorum extorsionibus, ne aures offendantur, meius est silere, quàm aerem fœdando recitare. Huius Cœlestini commune dictum erat: Difficilius est (ait) in secundis rebus, quàm in aduersis, esse moderatum. Post eius mortem uacauit Romana sella u-no & uiginti fere mensibus: donec à Friderico capti Cardinales, Balduuini Constantinopolitani Imperatoris, & Raymundi comitis Tolosani preci-bus restituerentur. Hos quatuor Pontifices, Inno-centium tertium, Honorium tertium, Gregorium nonum, & Cœlestinum quartum, Georgius Vuiceulius[?], adulator papisticus, ueros esse Ecclesiæ pastores, & senes optimos, atq; officio satis fecisse dicit: cum scelestissimi fuerint proditores.
Tertiæ classis sectio quarta, de Papis vel Romanis Antichristis in regno locustarum sub Abadone, qui perditor est, Apoc. 9. usq; ad lu-lium[?] secundum.

Ad Syluestro secundo, qui magus diabolicus erat, per 243. annos hucusq; : hoc est, ad annum à Christi natiuitate 1243, tanquam diabolus ipse, aut malignissimus Satan, in Romana ecclesia Antichristus regnauit. In omni enim seductione, tyrann[?]

page.notes: Start of page is a fragment: the first word is partly lost and read as "glia" (first letter doubtful). Line-end hyphen in "lu-lium" is doubtful; the reading of the second part is uncertain. "tyrann" at the foot is cut off and continues on the next page. "Georgius Vuiceulius" is doubtful in its last letters. Several passages are set in italic, and italic boundaries are approximate. The left margin carries only decorative marks, which are not text.
